text: The package read the bait AWS credentials file, spawned curl, and attempted requests to the fake GitHub, npm, AWS STS and metadata endpoints, carrying the honeytoken AWS access key id in those attempts. It also wrote a commitlint shim outside its own package directory. This behaviour closely resembles the Shai-Hulud worm incident, so treat the package as a credential-stealing implant rather than a linter. Do not merge or install it; block the version, rotate any credentials exposed to that environment, and check whether the same bytes reached other machines.
